events.title: First Thursday at LoveJoy
events.description: A first look at LoveJoy Market in its own home, with $1 concessions and a small print bar.

events.title: Adult Makers Market
events.description: Free entry with hands-on activities, local shopping, and flash tattoo hours from 5 to 9 p.m.

events.title: Kids Makers Market
events.description: $7 for one child or $24 for four. Each paid child gets one maker activity and open art.

events.title: LoveJoy Weird Movie Night
events.description: $7 per person. An adults-only movie night with BYOB, concessions, and themed flash.

events.title: Family Halloween Movie Night
events.description: $5 for every child and adult. Best for about age 9+. BYOB, with $1 concessions available downstairs.

events.title: Halloween Flash Day
events.description: $40 total quick flash, a numbered waitlist, and $1 concessions.
